description: Exact Linux AppImage runtime source inventory. Ubuntu package ownership is established by GNU ELF build-ID matches against RPCS3 CI OCI layers and dpkg metadata. Arch package versions are established by ELF build-ID matches against the 2026-05-16 Arch archive. Each package includes its versioned build recipe and upstream sources. Custom build mappings are recorded separately.

evidence: GitHub currently generates 10-character blob indices. Restoring 9-character indices reproduces Arch recipe SHA512 39a4ad7f473e4c170fb91a2e14860eaa6e728e9b710185bf9dbb23b949064fe7e51e36a15ec5ea110760ca8af15f8d2450e02e1a442af66516fe3e8b2debda0d exactly.
The original git.0pointer.net host has a TLS hostname mismatch. This HTTPS mirror serves the unchanged upstream commit; shallow fetch and git fsck --full verified the pinned object.

submodule_coverage.note: Exact revision is the gitlink in the main upstream source; recursive source snapshot includes this submodule. Recipe uses local clone only as fetch URL.
